manifest: TechJam Track 4 Shopping Copilot - results provenance
purpose: Binds every retained result artifact to the exact code that produced it: commit -> starter/agent.py SHA-256 -> evaluator command -> artifact SHA-256 -> headline metrics. Satisfies the retention requirement in docs/final_evaluation_faq.md section 1 and docs/submission_rules.md 'Final Evaluation and Code Freeze'.

evidence_classes.official_evaluator_result: Produced by an unmodified run of evaluator/local_evaluator.py. The only class that may be called a measured metric.
evidence_classes.diagnostic: Produced by tools/diagnostics/. Offline replay, oracle bound, or counterfactual. Never an official result and never comparable to one.

verification: For each entry: `shasum -a 256 <artifact>` must equal artifact_sha256, and `git show <agent_commit>:starter/agent.py | shasum -a 256` must equal agent_sha256.

official_runs.note: Baseline before E010. Adaptive clarification plus the M6 _product_terms memoization.
Proximity-aware reranking. Pure same-set reorder at pool depth 10; moved MRR only.
Candidate pool 50 with truncation after reranking. Superseded as submission baseline by E012, then E013.

Candidate pool 50 -> 100, holding E001's 70/30 primary/insurance ratio. Three constants, zero logic changes. The evaluator run preceded this commit; agent_commit is the commit that contains the evaluated file, and agent_sha256 is that file's hash.

CURRENT BEST / submission baseline. Clause-level evidence units plus front-loaded open-ended clarification, preregistered and evaluated as one indivisible coupled change. The evaluator run preceded this commit; agent_commit is the commit that contains the evaluated file, and agent_sha256 is that file's hash.

current_submission_baseline.provenance_note: The submitted starter/agent.py is byte-identical to the agent evaluated for the E013 result. Same SHA-256, no divergence of any kind.

independent_reproduction.note: Each experiment is run on the official evaluator exactly once by project policy. The only independent reproduction performed to date was at E011; it is recorded below and is evidence about this pipeline's determinism, not about the E013 result specifically.

diagnostic_artifacts.contents: R009 D-1 candidate oracle, D-2 perfect-reranker bounds, D-3 counterfactual bench.
diagnostic_artifacts.warning: Oracle and counterfactual figures in this file are upper bounds and offline replays. They are NOT measured system performance and must never be reported alongside official metrics without the diagnostic label.

experiments_without_artifacts.policy: A REVERTED experiment does not earn a tracked per-session snapshot (tools/diagnostics/README.md, 'Result snapshots'). Their official metrics are recorded in EXPERIMENTS.md and PROJECT_STATE.md.

cancelled.D012: Cancelled unrun after docs/final_evaluation_faq.md section 1 falsified its premise. No result exists and no number may be cited.

final_evaluation_retention.status: NOT YET AVAILABLE - the 800-session package is released after the Devpost deadline
final_evaluation_retention.requirement: docs/final_evaluation_faq.md section 1; docs/submission_rules.md 'Final Evaluation and Code Freeze'
